# comfyui-MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize-T8 v0.3.7

## 中文

- 修复 Windows 将外置 `release-manifest` 与 `SHA256SUMS` 写成 CRLF 的问题；ZIP、manifest 和校验和文件现在都使用显式 LF 字节，可在 Windows/Linux 生成完全一致的三个制品。
- Artifact 上传/下载 Action 升级到 Node.js 24 版本并固定完整 commit SHA，消除 v0.3.6 流水线中的 Node.js 20 弃用警告。
- 运行时功能、模型权重 revision 与 OpenMOSS 审计基线不变；其余修复内容见 v0.3.6 Release Notes。

## English

- Fixed Windows CRLF translation in the external release manifest and SHA256SUMS. The ZIP, manifest, and checksum file now use explicit LF bytes and are identical across Windows and Linux builds.
- Upgraded the artifact upload/download actions to Node.js 24 releases pinned by full commit SHA, removing the Node.js 20 deprecation warnings seen in the v0.3.6 workflow.
- Runtime behavior, model-weight revision, and the pinned OpenMOSS audit baseline are unchanged. See the v0.3.6 notes for the full bug-fix set.
